### Yahweh Versus Dagon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/yahweh-versus-dagon
Passage: 1 Samuel 5:4
Points:
- Ancient Near Eastern nations believed defeating an opponent proved their localized deity was superior.
- The Philistines placed the captured ark beside Dagon to absorb Israel's God into their own pantheon.
- Yahweh demonstrated His supremacy over Dagon by causing the idol to fall and severing its head and hands.
- The event proved that God is not a mere tribal deity, but sovereign and free to judge anywhere in the world.
- Christians must guard against religious syncretism and avoid mixing true worship with superstition or false practices.

### What Does the Story of Dagon Tell Us about Our Idols Today?
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/story-dagon-idol-god-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 5:4
Points:
- While the Philistines slept thinking they had triumphed, the Lord who never slumbers was actively at work.
- Idolatry occurs whenever people elevate anything—even good gifts—above God in their hearts.
- Dagon prostrated before the ark foreshadows that every knee will ultimately bow before Jesus Christ.
- The severing of Dagon's head and hands reveals the ultimate powerlessness and ruin of false gods.
- Believers can find courage knowing that no darkness or weapon of the enemy can stand against God.
